title: NROL-16 on Walpurgisnacht, matching a Necronomicon rite

tellings.quote: The launch itself happened on 12:50 a.m. on April 30th, 2005. This happens to be the same day of Walpurgisnacht,

plain: A secret US spy satellite launch called NROL-16 went up at 12:50 a.m. on April 30, 2005, which Michels says is the same day as Walpurgisnacht, a European night traditionally linked to witches. Michels tells it himself, citing a former intelligence officer named John Ramirez, and ties the date to a ritual in the Necronomicon, a book of occult spells, as a sign that the space program has a hidden ritual side.
